name: ImageGeneration
summary: The wait while an image is generated, in the finished picture's own frame: a moving field (the owner's watai stipple, the AI colours, a sharpening preview or a quiet shimmer) under one line saying what's happening, then the picture fading in where the wait was. A failure stays in the same frame with its reason and Retry. Not for loading an existing picture (Image with Skeleton) or for a view's skeleton.
a11y: A `figure` marked busy while generating; the status line is real text, announced politely when generation starts, when the picture is ready ("Image created") and assertively when it fails. The moving field is hidden from assistive technology. Reduced motion holds every variant still (one frame of the field), keeping the words and timing.

props.name: state
props.description: `generating` while the model draws; `done` once the picture is ready (give `src`); `failed` with `error`.

props.name: variant
props.description: How the wait looks. `stipple` (default): the owner's watai field, dots drifting like slow smoke. `aurora`: the AI colours panning under a soft sweep. `reveal`: the model's partial `preview` sharpening as `value` rises. `shimmer`: a quiet light passing, for a short wait such as downloading a finished picture.

props.name: ratio
props.description: The picture's shape, reserved from the start so the finished picture takes its place without anything moving.

props.name: label
props.description: Present tense while generating: "Creating image" (default), "Adding the lighthouse".

props.name: value
props.description: How far along, 0 to 100, only from a real total (steps the model reports). Shows a bar under the words.

props.name: error
props.description: What went wrong, in the person's words: "Couldn’t create this image. Try a different description."
